steps.title: Define token
steps.learning_goal: Recognize the core meaning of token.
steps.explanation: A token is simply a local name used for a small named item. It is a naming term, not a prescribed operation or process.
steps.connection_to_previous: This is the starting definition for the term.

steps.title: Identify the naming role
steps.learning_goal: Distinguish the token from the item it names.
steps.explanation: The token is the name or label; the small named item is the thing being referred to. Keeping these roles distinct prevents treating the token as the item itself.
steps.connection_to_previous: Once the term is defined, separate its naming role from its referent.

steps.title: Understand local scope
steps.learning_goal: Understand why the name is described as local.
steps.explanation: The token functions as a name within a relevant local context. The note does not specify a broader execution model, state change, formula, or geometry.
steps.connection_to_previous: The naming relationship is clarified further by identifying the context in which the name is used.
